name: Liberty Starfield Scatter
desc: An omnidirectional scattered field of 5-point liberty stars at every rotation — bright micro-glint cores (M), a separate signed roughness halo per star (R), and an independent translucent clearcoat constellation web (Cc). The abstracted canton: stars everywhere, no upright grid.

name: Stripe Corridor Sheen
desc: The 13 stripes abstracted into a MULTI-DIRECTIONAL sheen-corridor field: 3-5 broad anisotropic 'lanes' each running a DIFFERENT random angle, so the stripe-feel survives any rotation. M = lane gloss bands; R = signed brush grain ACROSS the lanes; Cc = soft corridor pooling on its own lane set.

name: Firework Burst Radial
desc: Scattered radial firework bursts at random centers — inherently rotation-proof. M = bright burst spokes that ramp dark at the tips; R = expanding signed shock-RINGS on a separate center set; Cc = a soft glow corona + falling ember trails on a third set. A living burst field.

name: Eagle Brocade Relief
desc: The eagle abstracted into an OMNIDIRECTIONAL feather-brocade relief — interlocking feather-scale lozenges tiled at varying angles like an heraldic brocade, never one upright bird. M = raised feather-scale edges; R = signed barb grain inside each scale; Cc = damask diamond overlay on its own lattice.

name: Liberty Color-Flip
desc: A LIVING red/white/blue color-flip clearcoat: the spec shifts which channel dominates as the viewing/sun angle sweeps, so the panel flashes red-to-white-to-blue. M = a smooth thin-film phase field; R = an inverse-phase signed field; Cc = a third phase-shifted field at a different frequency — three offset interference waves give the angle-reactive tricolor flip.

name: Brushed Steel Drift
desc: A multi-directional anisotropic brushed-metal field — like brushed steel that curves and swirls in several directions at once, evoking a flag furling in wind without any literal stripes. M = flowing brush highlights along a curl field; R = signed cross-grain micro-scratches on a perpendicular flow; Cc = broad satin sheen pools on a slow swirl.

name: Sparkler Ember Dust
desc: Handheld-sparkler ember dust: dense scattered hot micro-sparks with short radiating spark-jets, plus drifting smoke. M = ultra-fine bright spark grains + tiny radiating jets; R = signed soot/smoke streaks on their own drift; Cc = soft warm glow blooms around spark clusters. Festive, omnidirectional, fine-detail.

name: Liberty Torch Flicker
desc: Living flame-tongue flicker like the Statue of Liberty's torch: scattered upward-licking flame lobes at random local angles with a heat-shimmer warp, tuned to feel like it's flickering. M = bright flame-tongue cores; R = signed heat-shimmer roughness warp on its own noise; Cc = a separate ember-glow gradient that pools at lobe bases.

name: Capitol Marble Veins
desc: White-marble Capitol veining: branching translucent veins wandering across a polished stone field, evoking the marble of national monuments. M = bright polished vein ridges; R = signed micro-fracture grain on a different vein network; Cc = deep translucent vein interiors + soft calcite cloud mottling on its own field.

name: Canyon Relief Bevel
desc: Fake-3D faceted canyon-bevel relief: a Voronoi-shattered terrain of angular plateaus where each facet gets a directional bevel highlight, giving a carved monument-stone feel. M = facet bevel highlights (top-lit per-facet random light); R = signed valley-edge roughness on the facet borders; Cc = a smooth ambient-occlusion depth pool independent of facet lighting.

name: Star Lattice
desc: Multi-scale five-point liberty stars scattered at random sizes AND random rotations across the surface — never a grid, never upright. Reads as a constellation of stars from any panel angle. White-silver star bodies with a faint blue halo.

name: Stripe Drift
desc: Tapered red-and-white bands that drift across the surface at many DIFFERENT angles, widening and pinching as they go — the spirit of flag stripes freed from being parallel. No two bands share a direction, so it never reads as a literal 13-stripe flag.

name: Bunting Scallop
desc: Scattered swags of patriotic bunting — nested circular-arc scallops — flung across the surface at random rotations, like festival bunting draped every which way. Each swag is a stack of arcs in alternating red/white/blue, never hung in one straight upright row.

name: Distressed Flag
desc: An all-over weathered patriotic texture — cracked, faded, sun-bleached red/white/blue worn into the surface like a battle-worn vintage flag. There is no flag shape; it is a continuous distressed field of fractured paint and grain carrying the colors everywhere.

name: Eagle Crest
desc: An omnidirectional brocade of abstract eagle crests — swept wing-fan rosettes radiating in every direction with a bright shield heart — scattered like heraldic damask rather than one upright bird.

name: Firework Radial
desc: Bursting fireworks scattered across the surface — multiple radial spark-bursts of varied size detonating from random points, each a fan of fine spokes with a white-hot core and a sparkle shell. Bursts point outward in all directions, so there is no up.

name: Constellation Field
desc: An irregular night-sky field of liberty stars — glowing points of varied brightness scattered with faint connecting lines, like constellations. Stars twinkle in size, connections wander, nothing aligns to a grid.

name: Ribbon Weave
desc: An omnidirectional over-under weave of patriotic ribbons — red, white and blue bands interlacing in a basket lattice built on two randomly-rotated axes, so the weave reads diagonally and never as a straight up/down grid.

name: Stencil Stars
desc: Spray-painted stencil stars scattered with soft over-sprayed edges and fine paint grain — like stars stenciled by hand at random angles and sizes, with bleed and speckle around each. Worn, tactile, all-over; no aligned rows.

name: Liberty Filigree
desc: Omnidirectional scrollwork — sweeping liberty filigree of rose-curve and spiral flourishes radiating from scattered hubs in every direction, like engraved coin ornament wrapped around the whole surface. Continuous, ornate, never an upright crest.

name: Old Glory Flux
desc: Deep navy lacquer dusted with an omnidirectional field of tiny red-and-white star-flecks under a multi-directional color-shift sheen that travels from red through white to blue as the car turns; no upright flag, the patriotic read is pure palette plus angle-flux.

name: Rockets Red Glare
desc: Several seeded firework bursts of concentric red and gold rings bloom across a near-black night field; the burst sparks are albedo-flat but mirror-metallic in spec, so the whole sky flares and crackles only when light rakes the panel.

name: Liberty Torch
desc: An omnidirectional field of licking flame tongues in red, orange and gold over warm ember-black; flames point every which way like a wrapped torch, so there is no top or bottom, just heat that glows hotter at the tips in the clearcoat.

name: Eagle Ascendant
desc: A dense gold-on-navy brocade of scattered feather and wing motifs at every angle, like imperial eagle damask wrapped seamlessly; no single bird, just an all-over heraldic weave that catches gilt light from any direction.

name: We The People
desc: Aged parchment cross-hatched with an all-over engraved guilloche of fine interwoven curves, like the back of a banknote; ink lines run in every direction with debossed relief that catches a low matte sheen, scholarly and document-old.

name: Midnight Militia
desc: Tactical matte multicam in muted navy, slate and olive blotches with a fine deep grain; dead-flat, light-eating cammo that breaks up the panel with soft organic patches and zero shine, built for stealth patriot builds.

name: Freedom Forge
desc: Molten steel poured into a cooling crust: glowing orange cracks web across cooling gunmetal cells with scattered white-hot sparks, like a forge mid-pour, the cracks blazing in clearcoat while the steel plateaus stay rough and dark.

name: Amber Waves
desc: Multi-directional rippling fields of wheat-gold grain bending as if wind crosses from several directions at once; soft sheen-corridors of light roll across the gold like sun on a prairie, warm and alive but never pointing one way.

name: Glory Chrome
desc: Liquid show-chrome brushed in several crossing directions and dusted with red, white and blue mirror flecks; a polished patriot mirror that throws crossed brush highlights and tri-color glints from any angle, full reflectivity with patriot soul.

name: Sparkler Dusk
desc: Dusk-purple twilight scattered with comet-spark micro-flake: hundreds of tiny tapered spark streaks at every angle leave glittering trails like handheld sparklers waved in the dark, each trail tipped with a hot white micro-flake that twinkles in spec.
